camera.reason: 50MP main camera on a large 1/1.95 inch sensor, but no OIS and no ultrawide.

performance.reason: Helio G100 Ultimate is smooth in daily use and light gaming.

battery.reason: 6,000mAh with 60W charging fills in about 55 minutes, the fastest in the bracket.

display.reason: HD+ IPS LCD at 120Hz, a step down from the AMOLED on the Spark 40 Pro.

build.reason: Plastic body but rated IP68 and IP69 with a 1.5m drop rating.

software.reason: Tecno has not published an update policy; Spark phones have historically had 2 years of patches and few OS upgrades.

value.reason: IP69 and 60W charging are strong, but an HD+ LCD at 68,500 trails the AMOLED phones at the same price.

availability.reason: In stock in four colours at PriceOye, launched in Pakistan in September 2026 with official Tecno warranty.

notes: Pakistan model is the 8GB 128GB 4G version with a 720x1576 screen per TECNO Pakistan. Only PriceOye was checked for stock. Update policy and weight (207g) are from third party listings, not Tecno.
